channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Scientists May Have Overlooked a Hidden Alzheimer's Culprit for Decades
item.description: For decades, research has centered on amyloid beta as a main cause of Alzheimer's, with billions spent on developing treatments.

item.title: Cornell Scientists Identify Rare Genetic Disorder in Long-Legged Cats
item.description: Two unusually long-legged cats helped scientists confirm the first genetically verified cases of Marfan syndrome in domestic felines.

item.title: Scientists may have solved the mystery of the Moon's two faces
item.description: Researchers may have resolved why the Moon's two sides differ so greatly, using samples collected from its farside.

item.title: Easier exercise as an adult may begin in childhood
item.description: Childhood exercise could offer a lifelong benefit, making physical activity less tiring in adulthood, according to a study.
